recruit-approvals.heading: Recruitment approvals
labels: Allow anyone to approve their own request — off by default. Switching this on removes the separation for everybody, not just administrators.

Allow a superuser to approve their own request — for a workspace where one person legitimately does both. Every time it is used it is recorded in the audit trail as a self-approval exception. An ordinary administrator does not get this; only a superuser.

Also raise a review when the requirement is redefined — on by default. A change that is not a higher bar but makes the people in the process the wrong people: the role became Electrician where it said Welder, the branch moved from Mumbai to Dubai, or the department, grade, team, trade or skill changed. Switch it off only if this organisation re-labels roles without changing what it actually wants.
